full_judgment: 2. The petitioner being plaintiff instituted, in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka a suit being Title Suit No. 6 of 1983 against the opposite party and several others for declaration of his title and recovery of khas possession in certain land. The suit was decreed ex parte on 18.8.84. On behalf of the opposite party an application under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure, hereinafter referred to as the Code, was thereupon filed to have the decree set aside. It was registered as Miscellaneous Case No. 307 of 1986. There being a failure on the part of the opposite party to make his co-defendants parties the petitioner took an objection that it was not maintainable for non-joinder of necessary parties and prayed for rejection of the application. By the impunged order dated 9.5.87 the learned Subordinate Judge refused the prayer. The petitioner now contends that the decision is wrong.
